text:
maria_cs: FYI team — small onboarding interruption for tenants provisioned Mar 10-12. I pulled an impacted list and flagged high-touch accounts. Need a customer note + compensation plan by EOD.

samir_se: Agreed. One concise template we can personalize. Key bits: apology, short root cause, what we fixed, status, comp, office hours link, survey.

jess_engineer: Root cause: token rotation triggered cache invalidation at the edge causing intermittent 401s for ~0.8% of sessions. Patch prevents aggressive eviction and backfills tokens. EU done, US rolling.

opsbot: deploy eu-redwood-01 finished; status=partial_success; error_rate=0.8% -> watching.

laura_prod: Confirming credit workflow. We can auto-apply a prorated onboarding credit and log batch id once confirmed.

maria_cs: Draft outgoing below, keeping it short for templating. Please review.

"Hi <Customer name>,

Were sorry — you may have experienced onboarding interruptions between Mar 10-12 while we rotated authentication tokens.

What happened: a token rotation caused a small number of sessions to receive 401 errors while caches refreshed.
What we did: deployed a patch to stop aggressive cache eviction and backfilled affected sessions.
Current status: rollout in progress; most customers recovered within minutes.
Compensation: a one-time onboarding credit (prorated) and up to 2 hours of live enablement.
Next steps: join office hours Thu 15:00 PT or reply to request 1:1 support.

— Redwood Inference Customer Success"
